paa_questions.question: Can I install a smart door lock myself?
What are the downsides of smart locks?
Which smart lock is best in Australia?
Can I install a smart lock on any door?

ai_overview.answer_markdown:
If you mean **Brighton, Victoria (Melbourne)**, here are a few installers that can fit and configure smart locks:

- SMART LOCK INSTALLATION – 24/7 locksmith service with a large number of positive reviews. Suitable if you already have a lock or need advice on compatible models.
- Smart locks Melbourne – Based in nearby Hampton and specialises in smart lock installations and upgrades.
- Brighton Security – Established local locksmith and electronic security company offering residential smart lock installation, alarms, and access control. [www.brightonsecurity.com.au](https://www.brightonsecurity.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Ostan Locksmiths – Installs and services digital and smart locks, along with general locksmith services. [brightonlocksmith.com.au](https://brightonlocksmith.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Typical installation pricing in Melbourne is often around **A$150–A$350** for a straightforward replacement, though costs can be higher if:
- the door requires drilling or modification,
- you need a new deadbolt or mortise lock,
- the installer is supplying the smart lock, or
- it's an after-hours or emergency job. [brightonlocksmith.com.au](https://brightonlocksmith.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you haven't chosen a lock yet, I can also recommend models that suit your door (e.g. Yale, Aqara, Lockly, Eufy, or Philips) based on whether you have a timber, aluminium, or uPVC door and whether you want fingerprint, keypad, Apple Home Key, or Google Home compatibility.
